Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group, and I've posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. About five minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the active production roster as of Jul 1, and Ruth acknowledged it in the thread.

I checked this against the channel history itself. Nobody in #strategic-pod posted a different count after that.
